observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Pinned Filters tab to the Taxonomic Filter picker, while retaining the existing Recent and other tabs. Pinned items are stored globally, so this tab can carry items from groups the picker does not offer. P1.F3.H5 replaces the inline filtering of pinned items with a call to filterPinnedForContext, which filters pinned items to only those whose source group is one of the taxo.
